adg_execute — DRIVE agv op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.adg_execute(adg, delay_prob=0.3, seed=0, max_steps=10000) (to call the implementation directly, import agvfleet; agvfleet.adg_execute(adg, delay_prob=0.3, seed=0, max_steps=10000); from the registry, opsdrive.get("adg_execute"))

Usage

Executes according to the ADG. At each time step, each vehicle stops with probability delay_prob (slipping, people, delays in loading).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

次の行動の依存がすべて済んでいる車両だけが 1 マス進む。返りは dict: trajectories(実際の位置の列)、makespan、collisions(同じマス・すれ違い)、deadlock(誰も進めず未了)、finished。
